text:
priya: Need a compact pilot acceptance definition for the Optimize Advisor (batching, prefix caching, quant recs, eval-triggered alerts). Customers want clear do/undo and what we promise.
sam: Pilot proposal: read-only recommendations in Console + webhook alerts for eval regressions + per-route opt-out metadata. No auto-apply during pilot.
evan: Engineering notes: we'll use a trace sampler (configurable % cap) to compute batch_size distribution and prefix reuse. Quant suggestions are estimates (simulated), not live quant runs for pilot.
nina: Ops: require a rollback path and a circuit-breaker: if p95 increases > 15% or error_rate > 1% post-change, ops will flip the route to previous config and notify the owner. For pilot we document manual rollback steps.
sam: Debounce policy: fire alert after 3 failing evals in 48h OR sustained metric delta > 2 sigma for 6h. Include `reason` and `confidence` in payload. Hash prompt ids for privacy.
priya: Pilot acceptance checklist draft:
- Console shows per-route recs with short rationale + confidence
- Eval alerts delivered to webhook with debounce and human-readable why
- Per-route metadata key `advisor_opt_out` respected
- Telemetry: batch_size_avg, cache_hit_rate, quant_confidence exposed
- Rollback CLI snippet documented
evan: Perf plan: three profiles (short-chat, long-document, streaming). Capture baseline vs sim-estimate for fp16/int8: p50/p95/p99 and eval delta.
nina: Billing note: recommendations should show an estimated token-savings and $ estimate but must NOT change billing until customer accepts. Display warning about possible billing/latency tradeoffs.
sam: Risk mitigation: require A/B guardrail and owner ack before applying quant. Provide dry-run mode that only records telemetry.
priya: Customer asks: Acme wants per-route pinning to disable quant. We'll support `no_quant=true` metadata for pilot.
sam: Docs: add quick rollback examples:
```
# disable advisor on route
redwood routes patch my-route --metadata '{"advisor_opt_out":true}'
```
priya: Action items: evan -> trace sampler + quant-sim prototype (3d), nina -> rollback runbook + dashboard tile (4d), sam -> confirm pilot customers (2d), priya -> sign-off coordination. Reconvene in 48h. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: deploy note: branch optimize-advisor/pilot -> staged; smoke tests queued :gear:
